messages.subject: 'Visit effect' (occu function)
parts:
Hi,
I use the occu function in unmarked and I suspect that detection
decreases during my visits: p(visit1)<p(visit2)… I would like to
program a « visit effect » but I don’t find how to do that.
Has anybody a solution? Thanks.

messages.author: 527e14923215b7e4
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] 'Visit effect' (occu function)
parts:
Hi Aude,

Here is an example in case you can't find one.

R <- 50
J <- 3
z <- rbinom(R, 1, 0.5)
y <- matrix(NA, R, J)
y[] <- rbinom(R*J, z, 0.3)

visit <- matrix(as.character(1:J), R, J, byrow=TRUE)
umf <- unmarkedFrameOccu(y=y, obsCovs=list(visit=visit))
(fm <- occu(~visit ~1, umf))
